article.story: SYRACUSE, N.Y. -- — Garwey Dual had 20 points and eight assists for Syracuse, Sadiq White Jr. added 16 points with 10 rebounds and the Orange beat Cornell 91-82 on Wednesday night. Dual made a pair of 3-pointers and was 8-of-9 shooting from the floor for Syracuse (3-2), which shot 54% (32 of 59) from the floor and 23 of 30 from the free-throw line. Luke Wilson chipped in with 18 points, hitting 8 of 10 free throws for the Orange. Gavin Doty added 13 points. Syracuse used a 12-2 run after the break for a double-digit lead, which it held for most of the second half. An 8-0 surge, capped by a pair of free throws from Anthony Nimani, pulled Cornell to 79-74 with 2:35 remaining. Dual answered with a 3-pointer and Doty followed with a layup and the Orange were up by 10 points with 1:09 remaining. Backup Mikehi Williams made four 3s and scored 18 points to lead Cornell (2-3). Nimani finished with 17 points and Mateen Rafiq had 15. Up next Cornell: at Morgan State on Saturday. Syracuse: hosts Lafayette on Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
